answer: SELECT CAST(SUM(DOCType='Unified School District') AS REAL)/SUM(DOCType='Elementary School District') FROM schools WHERE County='Orange' AND StatusType='Merged'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode=s.CDSCode WHERE s.County='Los Angeles' AND s.Charter=0 AND f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" < 0.0018
SELECT s.School, f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)" FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode=s.CDSCode WHERE s.County='Los Angeles' AND s.GSserved='K-9'
SELECT f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)", f."District Code" FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode=s.CDSCode WHERE s.AdmFName1='Alusine'

SELECT s.NCESSchool FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode=s.CDSCode WHERE s.CDSCode IN ('01751010130583','01612910137588','01611760134270') AND f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)"=(SELECT MAX(f2."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") FROM frpm f2 WHERE f2.CDSCode IN ('01751010130583','01612910137588','01611760134270'))

SELECT s.School, s.MailStreet FROM schools s JOIN satscores a ON a.cds=s.CDSCode WHERE s.DOCType='State Board of Education' AND a.rtype='S' AND a.AvgScrRead=(SELECT MAX(a2.AvgScrRead) FROM schools s2 JOIN satscores a2 ON a2.cds=s2.CDSCode WHERE s2.DOCType='State Board of Education' AND a2.rtype='S')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools s JOIN satscores a ON a.cds=s.CDSCode WHERE a.rtype='S' AND s.MailCity='San Francisco' AND s.DOCType IN ('Unified School District','High School District','Elementary School District','County Office of Education (COE)') AND a.AvgScrRead+a.AvgScrMath+a.AvgScrWrite>=1500
SELECT School, EILName FROM schools WHERE CDSCode='01612590136051'

SELECT COUNT(*)/12.0 FROM schools WHERE County='San Diego' AND OpenDate>='1980-01-01' AND OpenDate<'1981-01-01' AND DOCType IN ('Elementary School District','High School District','Unified School District')

SELECT s.County, COUNT(*) AS n FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode=s.CDSCode JOIN satscores a ON a.cds=s.CDSCode WHERE f."Academic Year"='2014-2015' AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)"*1.0/f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0.1 AND a.NumGE1500>=1 GROUP BY s.County ORDER BY n DESC, s.County
